hints.sentence: this year's owners chose the measure that suits their building, so price controls along the share of the week each building stands empty, from its load profile, and roof insulation along its roof per floor, from the cadastre and the register
a hotel's or care home's load dips while its guests or residents sleep, so its profile reads it as empty when it is lived in

controls save only while a building stands empty, nothing until about two fifths of the week, and the meter operator's 2025 profiles show each building's week; this year's controls applicants stand empty longer than the pilot's
roof insulation saves with how much roof a building has for its floor, which the solar cadastre and the register give; this year's insulation applicants have more roof per floor than the pilot's
